prompts.name: 01-overhead-outskirts
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide landscape high-resolution overhead game map design mockup titled 'ARK SIEGE — OVERHEAD PLAN'. Reference image 1 is actual game screenshot: match its simple stylized 3D anime game terrain, pale irregular stone paving, vivid moss grass, black steel industrial elevator with yellow hazard stripes and cyan rails. Reference 2 is actual modular prop kit: reuse these simple mossy walls, broken walls, barriers, crates, cliffs, foliage forms. This is a proposed expanded map, not a screenshot. Camera TRUE TOP DOWN orthographic, entire large wide playable map visible, no horizon. Design three nested defensive arcs across a valley, with enemy side at TOP and Ark elevator at BOTTOM CENTER. Three distinct approaches: left wooded switchback, central broad ruined roadway, right rocky drainage passage. All routes meet FIXED destructible defenses in succession: OUTER LINE across upper third, INNER LINE across middle, FINAL GATE around elevator plaza in lower third. Walls meet impassable cliff boundaries so cannot simply bypass them. Show pre-existing firing emplacements and small allied infantry silhouettes at choke points, gray mechanical crablike Raptures entering from top. Wide cross-paths behind each line let the player rotate between lanes. Rear elevator is square cage lift with black/yellow trim and cyan ring, not a medieval castle. Cyan arrows from elevator toward defensive posts for automatic reinforcement movement; red arrows from northern spawns down approaches. Labels few and legible in dark understated boxes: 'RAPTURE APPROACHES', 'OUTER LINE', 'INNER LINE', 'FINAL GATE', 'ARK ELEVATOR', 'Reinforcements'. Small footer 'Fixed defenses • Continuous enemy waves • No building'. Map fills canvas, small units establish scale. No construction UI, no build grids, no resource harvesting, no talent tree, no giant fantasy towers, no realistic cinematic painting. Readable production planning concept closely matching modest existing assets.

prompts.name: 02-frozen-outer-line
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate landscape gameplay mockup 'ARK SIEGE — FROZEN NORTH'. Input 1 actual runtime screenshot defines camera angle, chibi white-hooded Snow White gunner, modest stylized 3D rendering and black translucent white/cyan HUD. Input 2 actual modular kit defines simple walls, rocks, cover. Input 3 frozen region menu art defines ONLY snow/pine climate, do NOT imitate its photorealism. Show top-down action camera fairly zoomed out over an outer defense line in a snowy mountain pass. Snow capped simple grey wall modules and concrete barriers, dark icy pale stone paving, fir trees, faceted boulders, gently falling snow. Wall goes across scene, one fixed closed metal gate center, a cracked segment right under attack. White-hooded small player with big rifle stands behind barrier near center alongside 5 small helmeted mass-produced female Nikke rifle infantry, teal HP bars. 12 visually distinct chunky grey robotic Raptures with red cores coming from upper half, including one heavy attacking wall, red HP bars. Existing gun emplacement automatically shoots from left wall. Make tactical open movement spaces behind wall and distinct paths approaching it. Player fires rifle at wall breaker; use restrained tracer and impact effects. No human enemy soldiers. No building, repair hammer, construction ghost, resources or shop. Minimal readable HUD using actual game's style: top left 'DEFEND THE ARK', 'OUTER LINE'; top center 'WAVE 06'; small wall status 'GATE 72%'; bottom only compact HP / LMB rifle / RMB turret / SHIFT dash / E burst bar and 'LV 07'. No full talent tree, no claim all talents unlocked. Small corner 'CONCEPT MOCKUP'. Match game screenshot scale and simple assets, not a cinematic or illustration of a medieval fortress. Camera looking down with no horizon.

prompts.name: 03-rain-breach-reinforcements
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Landscape top-down gameplay concept 'ARK SIEGE — STORM FRONT'. Reference 1 actual screenshot defines game camera, stylized simple 3D chibi Snow White and industrial cage elevator: reproduce black metal square lift deck, yellow hazard stripes, cyan edge rails and cyan ground ring closely. Reference 2 modular kit defines walls, broken wall, rubble, barriers. Reference 3 only defines wet storm forest lighting and foliage; keep modest game rendering instead of photorealistic painting. Show the inner defensive line breached in a rainy forest map: upper third has a grey wall with destroyed center gap and rubble, mechanical grey spider Raptures with red cores pushing through toward center. Lower half has a surviving fixed defensive arc of concrete barriers and a fixed gun emplacement; white hooded Snow White player fights near that arc with two helmeted mass-produced Nikke infantry. Rear RIGHT of frame inside friendly territory, large clearly visible familiar square elevator cage has just risen with FOUR additional small helmeted rifle Nikkes exiting its open gate toward friendly line, cyan subtle movement chevrons. Ensure elevator and reinforcement soldiers unobscured, and no enemies behind friendly lines. Drenched stone paving, puddles, green ferns, dark trees at edges, overcast blue-gray light with readable silhouettes, visible diagonal rainfall, restrained warm muzzle flash, wet yellow hazard trim. High downward camera no horizon, playable space and path connections clear. Compact HUD matching actual screenshot black translucent panels white sans-serif cyan lines: top-left 'DEFEND THE ARK' and 'INNER LINE BREACHED'; top-center 'WAVE 14'; a small cyan notification above elevator 'REINFORCEMENTS ARRIVED'; bottom ability strip and 'LV 12', no full talents. Small corner 'CONCEPT MOCKUP'. No building menu, no player construction or repair, no resource economy, no medieval castle, no giant cinematic buildings. Fixed pre-existing defenses progressively destroyed by continuous MOBA-like attacking waves. Strong visual story of falling back and allied troops arriving, not tower construction.

prompts.name: 04-three-lane-overhead-current
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create NEW revised landscape very wide overhead MOBA MAP planning mockup. Critical user correction: ARK BASE ON FAR LEFT, ENEMY RAPTURE SPAWNS ON FAR RIGHT, THREE LANES RUN LEFT TO RIGHT. NOT top-to-bottom defense, NOT concentric fortress. References actual game screenshot and modular asset kit define stylized low-poly anime 3D moss ground, pale stone paths, simple gray wall sections, cliffs, ferns and black/yellow/cyan industrial elevator. True overhead near-orthographic entire wide map, no horizon, no UI obscuring map. One left base plaza with familiar square black steel cage elevator, cyan rails, yellow hazard markings and protected Ark entrance. Three roads fan out from left base: TOP LANE arcs along northern forest edge; MID LANE goes straight across center; BOT LANE arcs along southern rocky drainage. They end at THREE distinct red-lit Rapture entry points along far RIGHT edge. Broad forest/rock islands between lanes, TWO clear vertical cross-path corridors for hero rotations at left-middle and middle-right. All three lanes have THREE existing defensive positions arranged along their road: outer position nearest right, inner position halfway, final position near left. Each position is compact gun emplacement with adjacent destructible wall/gate and barrier, terrain closes bypass immediately around defenses. Small allied mass-produced Nikke infantry with cyan markers move RIGHT from elevator splitting into each lane; gray mechanical Raptures with red cores move LEFT from right spawns. Show asymmetric pressure: top lane outer destroyed with rubble and enemies advancing to inner; mid lane outer currently contested; bottom lane outer still intact with allied squad. Give clear labels in understated dark boxes: 'ARK', 'TOP LANE', 'MID LANE', 'BOT LANE', 'RAPTURE SPAWNS'. Header 'ARK SIEGE — THREE-LANE CO-OP CONCEPT'. Small legend 'Cyan: allied waves →    Red: Raptures ←'. Small labels for the three defensive columns 'FINAL', 'INNER', 'OUTER' ordered left to right. Dashed cyan arrows on cross-paths labeled 'Rotate between lanes'. Footer 'Fixed defenses • No building • Hold the Ark'. Large readable map, lane roads visually unmistakable, restrained arrows, no medieval castle, no construction controls, no talent system or numerical balance claims. Match project's simple asset silhouettes; planning art not claimed as implemented gameplay.
